verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to 'automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository' (github-docs-38), and GitHub markets it as secure, reliable CI/CD (github-docs-11). Community comments treat Actions as GitHub's CI/CD offering with included minutes (github-comm-20-refresh-ff2c9c37fa17992d, github-comm-17-refresh-5dfb371b53e44d0e). missing for 10: explicit documentation of workflow-as-code file definitions (e.g., YAML in the repo), explicit documentation of automatic triggers on push and pull_request events, hands-on corroboration of pipelines running on pushes and PRs.
